title: tico
author: tico
details:
tico is an emulator frontend with support for multiple retro systems through independently maintained emulator cores.

It provides a customizable home interface, game-library browsing, cover and artwork management, RetroAchievements integration, touch support, and built-in management for supported emulator cores.

Additional emulator cores and supporting files can be installed or updated from within tico.
changelog:
0.8.2

tico 0.8.2 fixes RetroAchievements sign-in, which failed for everyone on 0.8.1 with "Sign-in failed".

> [!NOTE]
> tico 0.8.2 works with the same 3.0.0 emulators as 0.8.0 and 0.8.1. Nothing to reinstall.

## RetroAchievements

- **Sign-in works again.** RetroAchievements now refuses sign-ins from apps that present themselves as a web browser, which tico did. tico now identifies itself as tico.
- **tico signs in by itself.** If your password is saved but games aren't signed in, tico signs in in the background after you pick your account, with no need to open Settings or start a game. You'll see "Signed in as …" once it works.
- If RetroAchievements turns down your password, tico doesn't try it again until you change it. If there's no connection, it tries again a minute later.
- When RetroAchievements refuses a sign-in without saying why, Settings › Accounts shows the server's answer (for example "HTTP 403") instead of only "Sign-in failed".

Achievements inside games were not affected: emulators already reached RetroAchievements correctly once tico had signed in.

## Updating

Open the Store in tico and install the tico update, or copy `tico.nro` to `sdmc:/switch/tico/` (over the old one).

If your account showed **Sign-in failed** in 0.8.1, you don't need to do anything: start tico 0.8.2 and it signs in by itself.
